documentation.content: One user's report took over 240 s; the client gives up at 300 s and falls back. Normal is 20-130 s. Usually Gemini 429 retries -- check the agent's logs.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="gameday-report" AND jsonPayload.event="report" AND jsonPayload.dry_run=false AND jsonPayload.elapsed_s>240
